subject: Civic Education
lesson: Explains the importance of being watchfull regarding the problems and challenges faced in day-to-day life: Teacher Activity: show video
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the importance of being watchfull regarding the problems and challenges faced in day-to-day life.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher begins by asking students to share a recent situation where they had to be watchful to overcome a problem or challenge. Students share their experiences, and the teacher connects these everyday scenarios to the importance of being watchful in day-to-day life. The teacher then shows a video that illustrates the concept, sparking class discussion and setting the stage for the lesson.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher introduces the concept of being watchful and shows the video.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students watch the video and take notes on key points.
lesson_development_steps.other: Formative check: Teacher circulates around the room to monitor student understanding and engagement.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher facilitates a class discussion on the importance of being watchful in day-to-day life, using the video and student notes as prompts.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students participate in the class discussion, sharing their own experiences and insights.
lesson_development_steps.other: Formative check: Teacher encourages students to connect their own experiences to the concept and facilitates peer-to-peer discussion.

summary: Consolidation and synthesis of key concepts: Students will summarize the importance of being watchful in day-to-day life, connecting their own experiences to the video and class discussion.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Formative assessment criteria: Student participation in class discussion, ability to connect personal experiences to the concept, and understanding of the importance of being watchful in day-to-day life.
post_activity: In-class assignment: Students will write a short reflection (5 minutes) on how they can apply the concept of being watchful in their daily lives, considering the video and class discussion.
